title: Conformal acoustic holographic lenses for wavefront control via geometry-encoded design
authors: Ceren Cengiz; Mihir Pewekar; Hrishikesh Kulkarni; Yunruo Ni; Nathan Sambo; Adam Maxwell; Eli Vlaisavljevich; Wynn Legon; Shima Shahab
matched_query: conformal acoustic holographic lens geometry-encoded wavefront control transcranial ultrasound holography
reasons: final journal version verified from the official Elsevier article page
summary_en: A subject-specific design and fabrication framework for skull-conformal acoustic holographic lenses. The method jointly incorporates anatomical geometry, target constraints, and wavefront optimization, with simulations across 20 cases and ex vivo human-skull validation of the reconstructed acoustic fields.

title: SVFNet: Underwater RGB-Sonar fusion classification via cross-modal contrastive learning and Global Query Spatial Attention
authors: Xiangyue Zhang; Yao Zhao; Junlin Li; Hongli Xu; Lu Liu; Haitao Gu
matched_query: underwater RGB sonar fusion classification cross-modal contrastive learning aligned sonar optical dataset
reasons: authoritative metadata verified from the official Elsevier article page
summary_en: A dual-stream RGB-sonar classification framework combining cross-modal contrastive learning with Global Query Spatial Attention. It also introduces R-S9, a real-world benchmark containing 3,732 spatiotemporally aligned RGB-sonar pairs across nine classes.
